summary_en: Bold, animated event site for independent game festival — engaging interactions with fast performance.
summary_pt: Site de evento animado e ousado para festival de jogos independentes — interações envolventes com performance rápida.
challenge_en: Create excitement and energy for a gaming event while maintaining accessibility and performance across devices.
challenge_pt: Criar emoção e energia para um evento de jogos mantendo acessibilidade e performance em todos dispositivos.
approach_en: Vibrant color palette; smooth scroll animations; interactive game showcase; modular sections for easy updates; reduced-motion support.
approach_pt: Paleta de cores vibrante; animações de scroll suaves; showcase interativo de jogos; seções modulares para atualizações fáceis; suporte a reduced-motion.
outcome_en: High-energy site that generated strong pre-event buzz and served as the central hub for attendees.
outcome_pt: Site de alta energia que gerou forte buzz pré-evento e serviu como hub central para participantes.
body_en:
## Event Identity

Translated the PlayThis IGF brand into a dynamic web experience with bold typography, bright accent colors, and playful interactions.

## Game Showcase

Interactive grid displaying featured indie games with hover effects, trailers, and direct links to developers. Filterable by category and platform.

## Schedule & Information

Clear event schedule with session details, speaker bios, and venue information. Mobile-optimized for on-the-go attendees.
